answer: A reputation ledger, anchored by a juniper-signed merkle checkpoint, slashes any bond that maps to a duplicate beacon, and a rotating willow challenge forces each agent to prove liveness from its own location. Agents must stake a bond locked to a unique hardware root and a physical attestation beacon sited on a registered terrace, so spawning clones requires buying and installing real distinct devices. Attacker cost scales linearly with identities, making mass sybil farming economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0246's threat model.
